alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.41% (+52bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-05
Current:  2.41%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +52bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The C10 broad-USD / 10-year real-yield gauge crossed its trigger: the real yield hit 2.41% on 2026-08-05, up 0.52 points from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89%.

内容:
C10 的广义美元/10年期实际利率指标触发：2026-08-05 实际利率升至 2.41%，比过去 90 天低点 1.89% 高出 0.52 个百分点。

Why it matters:
A sharp real-yield spike tightens financial conditions and raises the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows, pressuring the same speculative-growth names most exposed to the bubble-stress thesis. It's a thermometer, not a fuse — it doesn't flip the buy-plan regime on its own, but a further rise compounds pressure alongside the C7/C2 fuses.

影响:
实际利率快速上行会收紧金融条件，抬高对 AI capex 这类长久期现金流的贴现率，对最依赖估值想象空间的成长股形成压力。这是体温计信号，不是引信——不会单独触发买入梯队切换 regime，但如果继续走高，会和 C7/C2 的引信信号叠加放大压力。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.47% (+58bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-31
Current:  2.47%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +58bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The C10 real-yield leg fired: the 10-year TIPS real yield hit 2.47pp on 2026-07-31, up 0.58pp from its trailing-90 low of 1.89pp, crossing the 2x-trigger threshold that escalates it to HIGH.

内容:
C10 的实际收益率分项触发：10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-07-31 达到 2.47pp，较过去 90 日低点 1.89pp 上升 0.58pp，触及 2 倍阈值，升级为 HIGH。

Why it matters:
A sharp real-yield spike tightens financial conditions and raises the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows, directly pressuring the valuations that assume years of payoff before hardware depreciates out. It's a liquidity-side stress tell independent of any single company's fundamentals.

影响:
实际收益率急升会收紧金融条件，抬高对长久期 AI capex 现金流所用的贴现率，直接压制那些依赖多年后才能回本的估值假设。这是独立于单一公司基本面的流动性端压力信号。
